corrections: Only the final target inherits dependency_revision_ids; intermediate facts retain explicit predecessors and stable IDs.
Graph export reads nodes, revocations and edges in one deferred SQLite snapshot and releases the transaction before serialization.
Merged predecessor sets above 64 and duplicate content-addressed facts are rejected during preparation, before proof submission advances.
reviewed_invariants: Late claim-revision insertion failure rolls back facts, edges, finding status and previous revision lifecycle together.
Finding-status failure during cascading revocation rolls back the entire revocation; repeated successful revocation is idempotent.
Concurrent graph export contains no dangling edges and matches a reopened read-only export after writers finish.
Long-chain and shared-predecessor task views contain every persisted predecessor, exact edges and topological order within the byte budget.
The emitted graph digest is recomputable and repeated unchanged-state views are deterministic.
Fact IDs ignore local manifest names and intuition while binding project, proof and resolved dependencies.

source_commits.additional_tests: fact-graph/identity CLI tests and warnings-denied all-target workspace Clippy

isolation_method: Each staged source tree was checked at the same checkout root with other stages temporarily stashed. Restored snapshots were byte-checked and only these temporary stashes were dropped.
limitations: ASCII tokenization and the bounded recent candidate window do not establish multilingual retrieval quality or complete-history recall.
Scripted verifier fixtures and fact IDs do not replace independent mathematical review.
Native exact-artifact, real browser, compiled LaTeX, copied operator state, resource and install/rollback release evidence remain separate.
